newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea offers to sell dlrs in forward trade.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea offers to sell dlrs in forward trade.

text.p: South Korea's central bank was seen offering to sell dollars in forward trading early Friday to slow the U.S. unit's rise against the domestic currency, traders said.
The Bank of Korea offered to sell dollars at 883 won in three-month forward trading and at 897 won in six-month forward trading, they said.
The central bank denied the talk of interventions as it routinely does.
Shortly after the offer, the won was trading at 869.40 against the dollar, against an opening rate of 869.60, traders said.
